name: Ixia-c (Open Traffic Generator)
description: A modern, API-driven multi-container traffic generator implementing the Open Traffic Generator (OTG) standard for testing L2-7 network devices at any scale.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Multi-container architecture with controller, traffic-engine, and protocol-engine; all services available as docker images on the GitHub Open-Traffic-Generator repository

eval_notes: Vendor-neutral API-driven traffic generator with GTP support, making it excellent for 5G user plane testing. The OTG standard allows scripted test scenarios via snappi (Python) or gosnappi (Go) SDKs - ideal for agentic evaluation frameworks.
